package.name: Elec3D
package.description: Opens Elec3D board designs, KiCad footprints and netlists in a custom document-free 2D/3D viewer. Explicit export can write STEP assemblies or create matching B-Rep geometry directly in a FreeCAD document.

workbench.name: Elec3D
workbench.description: View KiCad footprints and netlists in a custom 2D/3D UI without creating a FreeCAD document.
